# form.getFieldSlots

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Return a table of coordinates for fields in a line.

```lua
local rects = form.getFieldSlots(line, fields)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `line` | FormLine | yes | the line where the field should be added |
| `fields` | nil or table | yes | table of specs for each field in the line (either a string, or a width). The available space will be splitted into all cells where specs have a zero-width |

## Returns

rects (table of Rect): the coordinates

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
form.getFieldSlots(line, nil)
form.getFieldSlots(line, {100, 0, "slot3"})
```
